Name: Ishbah
Summary: Son borne in Ezra's line, called the father of Eshtemoa.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:17: Son borne in Ezra's line, called the father of Eshtemoa.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ishbah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
